user.title: Connect to HippieTV
user.description: Enter the IP address of your Android TV device running HippieTV, then open the TV (Welcome screen or Settings → Web Server → Link a browser) and type the 6-digit pairing code shown there.

zeroconf_confirm.title: HippieTV discovered
zeroconf_confirm.description:
**{name}** found at {host}:{port}.

On your TV, open the Welcome screen or Settings → Web Server → Link a browser to see a 6-digit pairing code, then enter it below.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-link HippieTV
reauth_confirm.description: The saved token for **{host}** is no longer valid (regenerated or revoked on the TV). Open HippieTV → Settings → Web Server → Link a browser and enter the new 6-digit pairing code.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to HippieTV. Verify the IP, port, and that the webserver is running.
error.invalid_pin: Invalid pairing code. Make sure you typed the 6 digits shown on the TV.
error.pin_expired: This pairing code has expired. Open the TV, generate a new one, and try again.
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute before trying again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This HippieTV device is already configured.
abort.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the discovered HippieTV device.
abort.reauth_failed: Could not find the integration to re-link.
